Self-hosted, lazy-loaded official EthereumProvider 2.26.0 and AppKit 1.8.19.
The application wrapper is separate from the SDK. No SDK source was patched.

LICENSE.md is the unmodified WalletConnect Community License supplied by
@walletconnect/ethereum-provider. APPKIT-LICENSE.md is the unmodified Reown
Community License supplied by @reown/appkit. THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt preserves
available bundled dependencies' license/notice files. Two upstream npm packages
omit license files; their unchanged package metadata and readme are preserved
there, with their MIT declarations. The bundle retains esbuild legal comments.

The community licenses have commercial-use limits, including 500 monthly active
users or 2.5 million monthly RPC requests, as defined by their full terms. The
operator must review those terms and monitor actual usage. This bundle does not
represent an unlimited free plan; no paid plan or license was purchased.

provenance.json records the npm SHA512 integrity verification, bundle hash and
exact build versions. To reproduce in an isolated directory, use package.json,
package-lock.json, entry.mjs and build.mjs with npm ci --ignore-scripts, then
node build.mjs. No runtime CDN script or repository dependency is required.
